primary_endpoint: Relative reduction from baseline in liver fat content after 12 weeks.
efficacy_outcome: At week 12, liver fat content fell by 46.6%, 68.5%, and 57.1% with pemvidutide 1.2, 1.8, and 2.4 mg, respectively, versus 4.4% with placebo (p<0.001 for each dose vs. placebo).
safety_signal: Well-tolerated at all doses; no severe or serious adverse events.
